description: This file contains internal implementation details for PyTorch's vmap (vectorized map) functionality, including functions for batching, unbatching, validation, and the vmap decorator.

methods.name: int _validate_and_get_batch_size( flat_in_dims: list[int | None], flat_args: list, )
methods.description: Validates the batch sizes of input tensor dimensions and returns the common batch size.

methods.name: int _num_outputs(batched_outputs: Tensor | tuple[Tensor, ...])
methods.description: Determines the number of outputs from batched tensor outputs.

methods.name: tuple _as_tuple( value: Any, num_elements: int, error_message_lambda: Callable[[], str], )
methods.description: Ensures the value is a tuple of a specified length, repeating or validating as needed.

methods.name: tuple[tuple,int] _create_batched_inputs( in_dims: in_dims_t, args: tuple, vmap_level: int, func: Callable, )
methods.description: Batches inputs according to specified in_dims, returning batched args and batch size.

methods.name: tuple _unwrap_batched( batched_outputs: Tensor | tuple[Tensor, ...], out_dims: out_dims_t, vmap_level: int, batch_size: int, func: Callable, allow_none_pass_through: bool = False, )
methods.description: Removes batch dimensions and unpacks batched outputs.

methods.name: None _validate_outputs(outputs: Any, func: Callable)
methods.description: Validates that the function outputs are tensors or tuples of tensors.

methods.name: None _check_out_dims_is_int_or_int_tuple(out_dims: out_dims_t, func: Callable)
methods.description: Checks that out_dims is an integer or tuple of integers.

methods.name: _get_name(func: Callable)
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a callable object.

methods.name: Callable vmap(func: Callable, in_dims: in_dims_t = 0, out_dims: out_dims_t = 0)
methods.description: Deprecated; wraps a function to support batching via vmap, forwarding to internal _vmap.

methods.name: Callable _vmap( func: Callable, in_dims: in_dims_t = 0, out_dims: out_dims_t = 0, allow_none_pass_through: bool = False, )
methods.description: Internal implementation of vmap, wrapping a function to support batching with specified in_dims and out_dims.
